design: Four performance reference profiles plus the existing composition skill; no new installable skill is created by this map.

request-data.purpose: Async dependencies, request caching, RSC payloads, streaming and server request isolation.
triggers: request cache or RSC payload change
request-data.runtime_gate: Determine actual browser/server/SSR/API/RSC execution first; generic async rules also apply outside Next.js.

client-delivery.purpose: Imports, initial client payload, lazy loading, request deduplication and resource scheduling.
triggers: initial page payload or bundle growth
repeated client requests or resource priority change
exclusions: state/effect correctness without a loading consequence
client-delivery.runtime_gate: Check bundler, framework, SSR and initial-render requirements. Next-specific examples need a supported Next path.

react-runtime.purpose: Render identity, state/effects, hydration, DOM visibility, browser subscriptions and storage behavior.
triggers: lost component state or unnecessary remount
input responsiveness or repeated render/effect work
hydration mismatch or client lifecycle change
exclusions: component API redesign without a runtime consequence
react-runtime.runtime_gate: Check React version, compiler configuration and actual browser/SSR path before selecting individual rules.

javascript-hot-path.purpose: Measured or bounded costly loops, lookups, computation, storage and DOM work.
triggers: input scale or repeated work demonstrates a concrete cost
javascript-hot-path.runtime_gate: Require representative measurement or a clear complexity/scale bound; preserve ordering, mutation, lifetime and cache semantics.

component-api.purpose: Public component variants, composition and state ownership.
exclusions: replacing supported React APIs for style alone
component-api.runtime_gate: Verify React and consumer version range, neighboring conventions and public API compatibility.
